The role is hands-on and execution-heavy: shipping platform changes, building automation, partnering with InfoSec on IAM and Datasec design decisions, and contributing senior judgment to the team's most exposed work. The role operates with autonomy, owning problems end-to-end, making technical calls within its scope without waiting for direction, and knowing when to elevate versus move forward. What the person will own As a Senior Software Engineer you will work across the team's portfolio, owning the slices that fit their depth and partnering on the rest. The current portfolio includes KPMG audit response and evidence collection, EMU migration (user‑profile migration is the active Wave 1, with the Identity Hub workaround as the path forward), rollouts including Copilot Code Review, vibe‑coding profile work and the connected guardrails, the inactivity‑rule design, and IP control mechanisms. Beyond execution, you will be a senior voice in the team's design discussions: architecture decisions, integration patterns with Identity Hub, ITSec/IAM/Datasec touchpoints, and the cross‑pack discussions with Coding Tools, AI Enablement, and Enterprise Solutions. You will be one of the engineers shaping how GitHub‑change governance works in practice at Nubank. This role will also serve as a technical partner in shaping the team's GitHub platform strategy, working alongside the PM to evaluate GitHub's product roadmap, anticipate how upcoming features affect Nubank's governance model. What we are looking for Must-haves Demonstrated depth administering GitHub Enterprise at scale (10,000+ users), including EMU (Enterprise Managed Users), organization and repo‑level policy design, and rulesets. Hands‑on experience with GitHub Copilot administration and rollout at an organizational level. Proficiency with the GitHub API and automation via GitHub Actions, including building or maintaining CODEOWNERS structures and branch protection patterns at scale. Working knowledge of GitHub audit logs and the ability to trace a policy decision through to its downstream effects on users, repositories, audit trails, and connected systems. Prior experience operating within a regulated engineering organization, with working knowledge of how InfoSec, IAM, and Datasec functions interact with a platform engineering team. Track record of working cross‑functionally with security leadership, tooling/enablement teams, and engineering stakeholders — writing clearly, pushing back constructively, and building trust quickly across functions without formal authority over those teams. Nice‑to‑have Experience supporting or shaping an organization's AI‑adoption strategy as it intersects with developer tooling and platform policy (e.g., Copilot governance, AI‑assisted coding guardrails). Familiarity with running GitHub Enterprise in a multi‑business‑unit or multi‑pack organizational structure, including navigating competing stakeholder priorities. Experience partnering directly with external auditors (e.g., Big Four firms) on platform‑level compliance evidence or remediation. Chance of earning equity at Nubank. title: Reliability & Asset Integrity Engineer (Power Systems) - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Ex[...]
description: This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. Job Overview We are seeking a Power Systems Reliability & Asset Integrity Engineer to join the Reliability & Asset Management Division (R&AMD) under Power Systems Projects & Technical Support Department (PSP&TSD). PSP&TSD provides HV Electrical Equipment Specialized technical support to Power Operations. R&AMD is responsible for administrating Power Systems engineering studies, equipment life cycle management, reliability assessments, equipment failure analysis, digital transformation, maintenance strategy reviews & enhancement to ensure safe, reliable and efficient power supply to all company’s hydrocarbon production & other support facilitates. Your primary role is to provide support, consultation, guidance and assistance to Power Systems operating areas and projects including engineering analysis and assuring adherence to Reliability & Asset Integrity Management standards. Key Responsibilities Develop a Reliability, Availability and Maintainability (RAM) model for the electrical substations and distribution network. Develop and align specific RCM process focused on equipment function (not just design), enabling targeted identification and mitigation of functional failures. Develop, manage, update and monitor implementation of short and long-term asset management policy, strategy, initiatives and work plans for power system asset and ensure alignment with overall company Strategic Asset Management Program. Manage PS owned Substations by deploying Asset Integrity Management System (AIMS) Program. Manage Power Systems HV Electrical Equipment Life Cycle Managements Process. Develop and manage single point of failure assessment to sustain Power Supply in case of equipment failure. Evaluate risk-based maintenance methodology based on likelihood and consequences. Provide technical guidance and tools in the area of risk and reliability assessment and management to work groups involved with distribution infrastructure replacement, substation infrastructure replacement, and transmission infrastructure replacement. Perform Asset failure trending and analysis. Identify repetitive failures and perform RCA to avoid reoccurrence of failures. Perform data analysis using techniques (APM, RCA, Six Sigma (6σ) etc.). Calculate and update the asset KPI’s. Issue reliability program monthly reports (MTBF, MTTR, bad actors, etc) updating the equipment health progress, and reporting failures and successes. Oversees PS assets performance and report PS technical KPIs for T&D assets. Utilize SAP Failure Reporting Analysis and Corrective Action System (FRACAS) to document and track unreliability events and reliability improvements opportunities. Provide technical information for field unreliability events backed up with equipment history & process data intended for area maintenance. Review the PM Defect Reports and evaluate corrective actions. Participate in developing, revising and tracking Asset Management strategies. Supervise the documentation and development of asset inventory for each class of assets, asset condition, level of service and performance, risk signature, maintenance strategies, repair/replacement models, financial forecasts, and tactical and work plans. As the successful candidate you will have: Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering working on High Voltage Electrical Equipment. Have a minimum of 8 years of experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical Industry or Power utility in the field of Power Systems Reliability & Asset Integrity Management. Familiar with reliability programs such as (RAM, RCM, RMS, MTBF, Bad actors, etc.) including SAP system or equivalent computerized systems. Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP), Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE), TapRooT Analyst or 6 Sigma Certification is preferred. The ability to relocate to Dhahran, Saudi Arabia on a full time, expat basis. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Technical Coordinator
description: Would you like to deepen your knowledge of day-to-day offshore operations? Experiência com operação de alto giro e vários SKUs. Formação Superior completo em Logística, Administração, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas. Será um diferencial possuir pós‑graduação em Supply Chain, Logística Empresarial ou Gestão de Operações. Conhecimentos Técnicos Domínio de WMS, inventários e indicadores logísticos. Excel intermediário/avançado. Conhecimento em roteirização e gestão de transportes (TMS desejável). Noções de segurança, ergonomia e operação de máquinas (empilhadeira, transpaleteira). Habilitação CNH B (obrigatória). Será um diferencial possuir habilitação “NR‑11” ou experiência com empilhadeira (não obrigatório). Perfil Comportamental Perfil hands‑on, operativo, presente no chão de fábrica. Proatividade e tomada rápida de decisão. Organização, disciplina e foco em resultado. Liderança firme, porém justa; boa comunicação com diretoria e lojas. Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e alto volume de demanda. Visão sistêmica e orientação para melhoria contínua. title: MSF Access Regional Pharmacist America Hub
description: Job Title: MSF Access Regional Pharmacist America Hub Contract Type: Short-term contract Duration: 12 months Working Time: Full time Starting Date: ASAP Deadline to apply: July 10, 2026 Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil Reporting to: Head of Americas Hub Compensation and benefits: MSF practice is to offer the C&B package current in the MSF entity establishing the contract. I. BACKGROUND MSF INTERNATIONA Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency medical assistance to people affected by conflict, epidemics, disasters, or exclusion from healthcare. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 27 associations and 18 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information, and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF ACCESS Access to Products for Healthcare is critical to MSF's Social Mission. It refers to the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness, and quality of products for healthcare for the populations MSF assists and their communities. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve Access in past decades through the work of MSF’s Access Campaign. In 2023, the MSF International Board approved the set-up of a new organisational model for Access work in MSF, building upon the works carried out by Access Campaign. MSF Access team is transitioned from this process and has the responsibility of analysing and developing initiatives to address technical and structural challenges in ensuring equitable access to quality assured, affordable, adaptive and appropriate medical tools needed in MSF settings and beyond. The newly established MSF Access structure replaces the former Access Campaign with a broader scope of work, operating through five strategic regional hubs: Dakar, Senegal: West and Central Africa. Rio de Janeiro, Brazil: The Americas. Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia: Asia and Oceania. Nairobi, Kenya: Eastern and Southern Africa. Brussels, Belgium: Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa. In MSF Access team’s strategic plan and the annual plan 2026, enhancing strategic approach towards evolving regulatory landscapes and their impact on access in MSF settings has been included as one priority area for analysis. In the Americas, local and regional production and innovation, combined with regulatory convergence and harmonization, are increasingly central to ensuring sustainable access to essential health products. At the same time, regulatory complexity, fragmented approval pathways and limited sourcing options continue to constrain MSF operations and public health systems. This position strengthens MSF Access’ regional capacity to analyse, influence and engage on production, innovation and regulatory agendas, ensuring they are explicitly oriented toward access and public health needs, including MSF operational priorities. II. PLACEMENT The Regional Pharmacist is part of the MSF Access Americas Hub and reports to the Head of the Americas Region. The position works in close collaboration with the Americas regional advisors and has a strong functional link with the Analysis Department of the MSF Access team, a multidisciplinary group of experts working on medical, pharmaceutical, legal and policy issues related to access to health products. III. OBJECTIVE OF THE POSITION The objective of the position is to strengthen MSF Access’ understanding of local and regional production in the Americas, with a particular focus on how regulatory frameworks, harmonization initiatives, reliance models, policies affecting the importation, exportation and regional circulation of health products, and mechanisms designed to incentivize local and regional production create opportunities or pose risks for equitable access to quality‑assured medicines, diagnostics and vaccines, including how regulation shapes markets and access, influences market dynamics through systemic barriers and enablers, and impacts equity and the availability of essential health products across countries in the region. Through in‑depth regulatory and policy analysis, the position aims to generate actionable evidence to inform MSF operations, advocacy and engagement on local production, regional supply strategies, pooled procurement and other collaborative purchasing mechanisms, as well as broader efforts to improve sustainable and equitable access to health technologies across the region. IV. MAIN ACTIVITIES Understand existing production, innovation and regulatory landscapes (diagnostic core) Monitor and analyse existing national and regional production and innovation initiatives related to medicines, vaccines and diagnostics, including developments concerning: Technology transfer and licensing initiatives Public and regional manufacturing capacity Regional collaboration and coordination platforms Funding mechanisms and industrial policy instruments Regulatory approval pathways, market authorization processes, importation and exportation frameworks, procurement mechanisms, and reliance/harmonization mechanisms, and their interaction with market structures, shaping both the feasibility of local and regional production and its impact on equitable access, including product availability, pricing, affordability, and supply security Conduct desk reviews and ongoing analysis of existing regional and national policies, strategies and initiatives related to local and regional production and innovation. Map and analyse regulatory landscapes, harmonization initiatives and regulatory reliance models relevant to medicines, diagnostics and vaccines in the Americas, including key international, regional and selected national initiatives. 2. Identify barriers, risks and opportunities from an access perspective Assess how regulatory frameworks, harmonization initiatives, regulatory practices, procurement approaches and production incentive mechanisms influence: Equitable access to quality‑assured medical products The feasibility, sustainability and scale‑up of local and regional production Market shaping dynamics, including systemic barriers and enablers affecting access, affordability, and availability of essential health technologies Identify how regulatory and market-related constraints translate into inequities in access, including delayed approvals, fragmented regulatory systems, and limited reliance mechanisms across countries. Drawing on MSF operational experience in the Americas, analyse where existing production and regulatory approaches fail or succeed in delivering affordable, quality‑assured and appropriate products to MSF settings and underserved populations. 3. Translate analysis into access-oriented frameworks and MSF positioning Develop and maintain an access-oriented policy and analytical framework for public and local/regional production and innovation, explicitly grounded in: Public health priorities Equity and affordability Quality assurance MSF operational and humanitarian needs In collaboration with MSF Access team produce periodic analytical updates, technical notes and internal briefs to inform MSF Access strategic discussions and decision-making. Provide technical pharmaceutical input to MSF positions, policy documents and advocacy strategies related to local and regional production, innovation, regulatory pathways, procurement approaches and regional collaboration mechanisms, ensuring these are grounded in evidence generated through the diagnostic and analytical work, and explicitly incorporating analysis of how regulatory and market dynamics affect equitable access, affordability and availability of essential medical products in MSF operational contexts. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics. MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated. We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process. Note: All offers of employment will be subject to reference checks, including Human Resources, and to appropriate screening checks. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms his/her/their understanding of these selection procedures. Qualifications and Knowledge Degree in Pharmacy (mandatory). Solid knowledge of access to medicines and health technologies, including issues related to availability, affordability, quality and appropriateness. Understanding of local and regional production and innovation ecosystems, including public and private manufacturing models. Knowledge of regulatory systems for medicines, vaccines and diagnostics, including regulatory approval pathways, quality assurance, importation and exportation frameworks, and regulatory reliance or harmonization mechanisms. Familiarity with pharmaceutical policy, market dynamics and procurement is an asset. Basic understanding of intellectual property, licensing and technology transfer in the context of access to health products is an asset. Strong interest in public-health-driven and access-oriented approaches to local production and innovation. Commitment to MSF’s humanitarian principles and access-to-care mission. Professional Experience Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in pharmacy, pharmaceutical policy, access to medicines, regulatory affairs, public health analysis or related fields. Proven experience working in Latin American countries Experience related to local or regional production, regulation, procurement or access initiatives is a strong asset. Prior experience with MSF or other humanitarian, public health or non-profit organisation is an asset. Skills and Competencies Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to identify barriers, risks and opportunities. Excellent writing skills, including the ability to produce clear analytical briefs and technical notes for internal audiences. Ability to translate complex regulatory, production and policy issues into access-focused insights. Strong communication and collaboration skills in multidisciplinary and multicultural environments. Ability to work independently and autonomously, while coordinating closely with regional and international teams. Capacity to manage multiple analytical tasks and deliver outputs within agreed timelines. Proficiency in spoken and written English, Spanish, and Portuguese Frequent international travel. #J-18808-Ljbffr

O nosso maior ativo são os nossos empregados e a diversidade é a nossa força! Saiba mais sobre a Tractebel , as nossas atividades e o porquê de se deve juntar a nós! No grupo ENGIE, cada talento tem um papel a desempenhar na aceleração da transição energética. Faça a diferença e desfrute de uma experiência profissional gratificante. Serving as the primary focal point between the shorebase and offshore assets, the coordinator will oversee warehousing, cargo handling, and vessel activities while supervising third-party service providers. Additionally, the role involves driving a strong safety culture, monitoring operational KPIs, and collaborating with multiple stakeholders to optimize efficiency during drilling, production, and subsea project phases. Responsibilities Responsible for the management, operational readiness and performance of BW Energy shorebase facilities, ensuring safe, efficient and reliable logistics support to offshore operations. Act as the primary logistics focal point between the shorebase and offshore assets, ensuring alignment of logistics priorities and operational requirements. Participate in daily operational meetings with the FPSO, Wellhead Platform, Drilling Rig and other project stakeholders to support the execution of Project activities. Ensure shorebase readiness to support drilling, production, subsea, construction and project activities throughout all project phases. Monitor and oversee all shorebase activities, including warehousing, yard operations, cargo handling, material staging, vessel support and logistics service providers. Ensure efficient planning and execution of shorebase logistics activities, supporting offshore operations through adequate allocation of resources and services. Monitor vessel activities during shorebase operations, including berth allocation, cargo operations, bunkering activities, water supply and coordination of additional port services when required. Supervise and monitor logistics service providers operating within the shorebase, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, operational requirements and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Monitor shorebase operational performance through KPIs, reports and operational controls, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. Support the monitoring of logistics contracts, service measurements, proformas and operational invoices related to shorebase activities. Promote and reinforce a strong safety culture across all shorebase operations and contractor activities. Ensure the proper implementation of emergency response plans, waste management procedures and oil spill contingency requirements related to onshore logistics activities. Identify and implement initiatives to improve operational efficiency, service quality and resource utilization. Ensure proper interface between shorebase operations, marine logistics, materials management, offshore units and logistics service providers. Monitor operational non-conformities, incidents and service deviations, ensuring appropriate reporting and follow-up of corrective actions. Support audits, inspections and compliance activities related to shorebase operations and logistics services. Ensure that relevant requirements of the Management System are used as the terms of reference for the activities controlled. Undertake training relevant to the position requirements. On-the-job training of colleagues and trainees. Assist in any other work specified by Department Head. Education Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, Engineering, Maritime Studies or a related field is desirable. Experience Relevant experience in offshore logistics, shorebase operations, port operations or similar logistics leadership positions. Proven experience supporting offshore drilling, production, subsea, construction or development projects. Previous experience managing logistics service providers, shorebase contracts and offshore support operations. Knowledge Knowledge of offshore logistics, shorebase operations and port logistics. Knowledge of offshore drilling, production, subsea and construction support operations. Knowledge of logistics contracts, contractor management and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Knowledge of cargo handling, vessel support and shorebase logistics activities. Knowledge of HSE requirements applicable to logistics and shorebase operations. Experience with ERP systems, preferably IFS or equivalent systems. Advanced English communication skills, both written and spoken. Advanced Microsoft Excel knowledge. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Ticketing Stadium Configuration Coordinator
description: Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. The Position Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Stadium Configuration Manager the Ticketing Stadium Configuration Coordinator will help building and maintaining stadium seating maps for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Working in close collaboration with the Configuration and Inventory team in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for the management of ticketing inventory, seating plans and its maintenance in the Ticketing System, ensuring data accuracy throughout the planning phase and during the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Key Responsibilities Assist the team in building complete and accurate seating plans in the ticketing system for selected FIFA tournament venues in the host country. Assist in the implementation of all necessary seating information and configuration of spectator flows, price categories and seat allocations and carries out required updates. Maintain seating maps and configurations within the ticketing system on a day-to-day basis throughout all stages of FIFA tournaments and apply changes as required. Ensure data integrity and accuracy of all seating information and configuration. Carry out seat assignment processes in the ticketing system. Support the team to liaise with other functional areas in the planning of seating configuration and spectator flow for selected venues. Assess and analyze maps and plans of FIFA tournament venues to identify gaps and changes to be applied in the seating plans and configurations. Carry out onsite seat inspection visits to fully validate seating plans as built in the ticketing system with the actual venue seating. Evaluate outcomes of quality inspections and propose corrective measures. Support the overall management of ticketing inventory by conducting quality assurance measures for both ticket quotas and seat allocations. Support administration of allocations and additional ticket requests during the tournaments. Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events systems. Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events. Your Profile Education Bachelor's degree or equivalent level of education. Experience Strong professional experience. Experience working with ticketing systems (preferably Secutix). Experience in working with CAD technical drawings considered as a plus. Highly accurate and detail-oriented working style, technology minded, efficient and accountable team player. Skills & Competencies Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Sharepoint, Teams, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. Strong analytical skills, detail-oriented, technology minded, efficient and accountable team player. Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities. Skilled in facilitating collaboration between various business areas. Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones. Certifications & Requirements Willingness to travel to host cities. Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time. Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred. Languages: Fluent in English and Portuguese. Proficiency in additional languages is valued. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written). Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written). Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Marine Operator
description: Responsibility The Marine Operator shall be responsible for the running control of the stability of the Ship, its position and draught, and shall assist in the stability calculations. The Marine Operator is responsible for ensuring that own day-to-day activities and those of peers, are carried out in a safe and healthy manner and that the impact of such activities on the environment is within acceptable limits. Specific Duties Always keep informed as to where supply vessels, stand‑by vessels and helicopters are located, and shall keep records of this information in the ship’s logbook. Monitors on the cargo and ballast control panel. Monitors the inert gas pressure and oxygen content of cargo tanks. Monitors all marine alarms and carry actions in accordance with instructions. Check that ballast and cargo valves are function properly. The check will be logged in the vessel's logbook. Faults discovered with valves in the ballast and cargo system to be reported to the Lead Marine Operator. Carry out the duties and tasks as specified in the Emergency Response Plan. Follow‑up as required for PTW issuing, execution and closure of it. Ensure that stability calculations are made daily. Carry out such work as has been required by own superior and carry out duties as per documented Company Procedure, including administrative or operational activities. HSE Responsibility Responsible for maintaining a high degree of awareness. Lead by doing; setting an example for others. Observe and report any unsafe activities, conditions or situations. If you observe anything unsafe use the ‘Stop Work’ Policy. Qualifications General education, certificates and experience: Regarding units in navigation, this professional shall have an endorsement/seaman’s book complying with STCW rule II/1 and the title of Deck Officer. Regarding units in operation, this professional shall have an endorsement/seaman’s book complying with IMO Circ. A.1079(28) – item 6.4, as well as the title of Ballast Control Operator. Experience from tankers and/or mobile unit Fluent English #J-18808-Ljbffr

Apoio às lideranças: colaborar com os gestores na elaboração e atualização de descrições de cargo, estruturação de equipes, levantamento de necessidades e identificação de melhorias nos processos de gestão de pessoas. Endomarketing e clima organizacional: planejar e executar ações de endomarketing, datas comemorativas, campanhas internas e estratégias que promovam o engajamento, motivação e integração entre os colaboradores. Melhoria de processos: propor, revisar e implementar melhorias nos processos de RH, buscando mais agilidade, eficiência e alinhamento com as boas práticas de gestão de pessoas. Supervisão e orientação da equipe de apoio: acompanhar e orientar o trabalho das jovens aprendizes, estagiárias e assistente de RH, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de aprendizado constante. Rotinas administrativas de RH: garantir a organização de documentos, atualização de sistemas, controle de ponto, apoio na folha de pagamento (em parceria com o DP), benefícios e suporte geral aos colaboradores. title: FARMACEUTICO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description: Preparo, distribuição, dispensação e controle de medicamentos e produtos para a saúde; otimização da terapia medicamentosa; informação sobre medicamentos e produtos para a saúde; ensino, educação permanente e pesquisa. Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII) , há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em psiquiatria e obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e Atribuições Cumprir a legislação vigente relativa ao armazenamento, conservação, controle de estoque de medicamentos, produtos para a saúde, saneantes, insumos e matérias-primas, bem como as normas relacionadas com a distribuição e utilização dos mesmos. Estabelecer um sistema eficiente, eficaz e seguro de transporte e dispensação, com rastreabilidade, para pacientes em atendimento pré-hospitalar, ambulatorial ou hospitalar, podendo implementar ações de atenção farmacêutica. Participar das decisões relativas à terapia medicamentosa, tais como protocolos clínicos, protocolos de utilização de medicamentos e prescrições; supervisionar o fracionamento de medicamentos. Desenvolver e participar de ações assistenciais multidisciplinares, dentro da visão da integralidade do cuidado, interagindo com as equipes de forma interdisciplinar. Realizar ações de farmacovigilância, tecnovigilância e hemovigilância no hospital e em outros serviços de saúde, notificando as suspeitas de reações adversas e queixas técnicas, às autoridades sanitárias competentes. Promover ações de educação para o uso racional de medicamentos, produtos para a saúde e saneantes, aos demais membros da equipe de saúde. Exercer atividades de ensino, por meio de programas educacionais e de formação (treinamento e educação permanente) e programas de pós-graduação (Residência em Farmácia Hospitalar), contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de recursos humanos. Desenvolver ações de gerenciamento de riscos hospitalares, como detecção de reações adversas a medicamentos, queixas técnicas, problemas com produtos para a saúde, saneantes, kits diagnósticos e equipamentos. Prevenir e/ou detectar erros no processo de utilização de medicamentos. Zelar pelo adequado gerenciamento dos resíduos resultantes das atividades técnicas desenvolvidas nos serviços de atendimento pré-hospitalar, na farmácia hospitalar e em outros serviços de saúde, atendendo às normas sanitárias e de saúde ocupacional. Realizar e manter registros das ações farmacêuticas, observando a legislação vigente. Orientar e acompanhar, diretamente, auxiliares e técnicos de farmácia na realização de atividades nos serviços de farmácia hospitalar, treinando-os e capacitando-os para tal; a supervisão e/ou competência dessas atividades são de responsabilidade exclusiva do farmacêutico. Realizar outras atividades segundo a especificidade e a complexidade do hospital e os outros serviços de saúde. Requisitos e Qualificações Ensino Superior Completo em Farmácia. Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Farmácia Clínica, Atenção Farmacêutica ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde. Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe. Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Farmacêutico na área da saúde. Benefícios Alimentação no Local. Vale Alimentação. Assistência Médica (adesão facultativa). Assistência Odontológica (adesão facultativa). Disponibilizamos parcerias com Wellhub (Gympass), SESC, Zenklub, faculdades, universidades e farmácias. Auxílio Creche. Insalubridade de 20% do salário mínimo. Adicional noturno: 20% sobre a hora trabalhada, das 22h às 7h. Local de Trabalho Hospital Municipal Pedro II - CER Santa Cruz. Bairro: Santa Cruz - RJ. Escala: Plantonista Diurno (07:00 às 19:00) / Noturno 19:00 às 07:00 (12x60) ou 30 horas semanais. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Wallets (100% Remote)
description: About the job This is a role for someone who is genuinely obsessed with product. You will own the full lifecycle of a crypto wallet product used at global scale, from writing the first user story to shipping the feature to measuring what it actually did. You will set the roadmap, drive every sprint, and be the person every engineer, designer, and stakeholder looks to when a decision needs to be made. You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them. If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you. Key responsibilities: Product development and Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation and requirements gathering to delivery and post-launch analysis. Define user stories, acceptance criteria, perform backlog management and workflows for development teams. Technical Expertise: Translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable product requirements. Evaluate technical solutions and prioritize features based on technical feasibility, business impact, and customer value. Conduct extensive market research, including customer discovery to understand the value proposition of our product. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with developers, designers, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, validate and deliver solutions. Quality & Delivery: Ensure product features are delivered on time and meet quality standards; organize testing and feedback loops. Mandatory: 8+ years of product management experience with at least 3 years in a technical product management role. Past experience in building or managing crypto wallets with DeFi features. Excellent communication skills for bridging technical and non-technical stakeholders. A genuine team player who builds trust quickly, communicates with candor, and makes the people around them more effective. Bias toward action. You identify what needs to change, build the case, and move without waiting to be asked. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and get engineers, designers, and business stakeholders pulling toward the same outcome at the same time. Equally comfortable setting the strategy and rolling up your sleeves to execute it. You do not hand things off and disappear. Thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. You do your best work when the stakes are high and the timeline is short. Expertise in agile methodologies - Jira, Asana etc. Strong understanding of microservices, peer-to-peer systems, javascript. Strong organizational skills to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced, remote environment. Skilled in defining, tracking, and reporting on product KPIs to measure success; expertise in A/B testing or similar experimentation methods is a plus. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: MÉDICO CIRURGIÃO GERAL - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description: Descrição da vaga Prestar atendimento aos pacientes de acordo com a demanda, efetuando a história clínica, exame físico e hipótese diagnóstica, encaminhando o paciente a exames complementares quando necessário e realizando os procedimentos cirúrgicos indicados, zelando pela conduta e atuação dentro do princípio ético da profissão. SOBRE O HOSPITAL PEDRO II - CER SANTA CRUZ Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II. A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Realizar as cirurgias gerais do serviço de emergência e as cirurgias eletivas conforme a necessidade do serviço; Atender casos de emergências no CER ou unidade de internação, efetuando procedimentos de primeiros socorros e tomando os cuidados médicos necessários visando o restabelecimento do paciente; Solicitar exames subsidiários analisar e interpretar seus resultados e emitir diagnósticos; Prescrever tratamentos, orientar os pacientes, aplicar recursos da medicina preventiva ou curativa para promover, proteger e recuperar a saúde do usuário; Encaminhar pacientes quando necessário para outras especialidades; Atender as solicitações de avaliação por demanda dos demais especialistas da Unidade; Encaminhar pacientes quando necessário aos serviços de maior complexidade para tratamento e ou internação hospitalar (caso indicado); Estabelecer contato com a Central de Regulação Médica para os encaminhamentos; Realizar e responsabilizar-se por todos os registros sobre os pacientes em documentos da internação e prontuários conforme as exigências legais; Obedecer ao Código de Ética Médica e Regimento Interno das unidades; Zelar pela manutenção e ordem dos materiais, equipamentos e locais de trabalho; Participar das reuniões voltadas ao desenvolvimento técnico-científico da Unidade; Fornecer atestado médico seguindo as normas do código de ética médica; Responsabilizar-se pelas informações aos familiares e/ou acompanhantes com os esclarecimentos que se fizerem necessários de acordo com o código de ética médica; Realizar a passagem de plantão com as anotações e registros no livro destinado a isto; Participar da apresentação de casos e temas em visitas, reuniões, discussões; Utilizar de forma criteriosa os recursos terapêuticos medicamentosos e diagnósticos; Cumprir as normas e procedimentos do Departamento, zelando pela conduta e atuação dentro dos princípios éticos da profissão e diretrizes da Entidade; Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição. Requisitos e qualificações Ensino Superior completo em Medicina; Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista na área; Registro ativo no conselho de classe; RQE em Cirurgia Geral; Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função. Informações adicionais Local de trabalho: Hospital Municipal Pedro II - CER Santa Cruz; Bairro: Santa Cruz - RJ; Escala: Plantonista 12 horas - Diurno (07:00 às 19:00) / Noturno 19:00 às 07:00 ou Rotina - 10 horas. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Participar da elaboração de protocolos médicos e rotinas de trabalho. Realizar avaliação ortopédica quando solicitado por outras especialidades. Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.
